note: Forbidden: a Link-LSA that omits one of the router's addresses on the link. TestRFC5340LinkLSAListsLinkAddresses decodes the originated Link-LSA and asserts the link-local fe80::1 and both global prefixes 2001:db8:1::/64 and 2001:db8:2::/64, each red on omission; the eth1 half asserts each link's LSA carries its own link-local and prefix and not the other link's.
